description: Executable repository tasks for coding qualification (task 0452). Each task is a tiny self-contained repo with a bounded bug-fix, feature, refactor, multi-file, validation, async, or test-repair objective; a public test, hidden executable test, allowed edit paths, and golden solution diff. A candidate model is given the editable files, requirements, and public test and must produce a unified diff; executableRepoGrader applies it and decides pass/fail from exit codes and deterministic scope checks only (no LLM judge).
